curve.title: Consumption curve
curve.description: JSON object mapping elapsed time (HH:MM from the start of the run) to the energy consumed (kWh) during that step. Example: {"00:00": 0.1, "00:15": 0.2, "00:30": 0.1}

manual_options.title: Manual profile options

data.hourly_timer_only: Appliance only supports a 1-hour step timer

error.invalid_curve: Invalid consumption curve. Use a JSON object such as {"00:00": 0.1, "00:15": 0.2}.
